Christmas Card Maker privacy policy

Christmas Card Maker is made by Islefire. The app does its work on your device. It has no account, advertising, analytics or tracking. The app does not collect your data or send it to Islefire or third parties.

The app keeps your drafts and music selection on your device so you can resume editing. On iPhone and iPad, you can add music from Files. The app keeps a local copy of the selected file. On Windows, the app remembers the location of the music file you choose. The music you select is included in the exported video.

On Windows, you choose where to save your card. On iPhone, iPad and Android, you can save it to Photos or Gallery, or use your device’s Share menu to choose a destination. Any service you choose for a file, and any device backup you enable, is governed by that service’s settings and privacy policy.

Diagnostic logs are written on the device. On Windows, MSIX installs keep logs, drafts and the selected music path in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\<package family>\LocalState. Unpackaged Windows builds use %APPDATA%\Islefire\Christmas Card Maker. On iPhone, iPad and Android, the logs are in the app’s private storage. Logs can include the app version, device and system details, and errors. The app keeps up to ten recent session logs and has no automatic log upload. If you contact support, Islefire uses the information you choose to send to respond to your request.

You can delete saved cards from their destinations. Uninstalling the Windows MSIX or deleting the mobile app removes its local app data. For an unpackaged Windows build, you can remove that data from its AppData folder. For privacy questions or to request deletion of information you sent to support, contact Timo at tsaari42@gmail.com.
